conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Smartphones are primarily designed for communication and portability, while tablets offer a larger screen for media consumption and productivity. The main differences lie in their size, typical use cases, and whether they include cellular call functionality.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Not necessarily; while some high-end tablets might have similar or even superior processing power, it generally varies greatly depending on the specific model and its intended use.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For instance, a flagship smartphone like the latest iPhone often boasts a very powerful chip, comparable to or exceeding some mid-range tablets designed for general use. Conversely, a high-end tablet like the iPad Pro features chips specifically engineered for demanding tasks, often surpassing many smartphones.
